scope: Human-inspected manufacturer/eval-board screenshot evidence for the E02 RGB polarity correction. No vendor PDF is stored in the repository.

inspected_screenshots.observed: Polarity drawing: pin 3 is common positive/anode; pin 1 red cathode, pin 2 green cathode, pin 4 blue cathode; package 1.6x1.6x0.35 mm.
Electro-optical table at IF=20mA: Vf max BH=3.8V, R6=2.4V, GH=3.8V; note states forward-voltage tolerance ±0.1V.
Figure 4 FxLED 9x13 schematic shows SW rows sourcing RGB package common nodes and CS color lines sinking the individual LED cathodes.
EVB BOM lists 117 Everlight A01-family RGB LEDs; the BOM text reads 9-237/R6GHBHC-A01/2T. This supports A01/common-anode architecture but is not used as exact SKU authority.

observed: CS1..CS39 are specified as current-sink pins for the LED matrix.
SW1..SW9 are specified as source/switch pins for the LED matrix.
VHR maximum test points are 600mV at ISINK=38mA and 750mV at ISWITCH=800mA; E02 does not reuse those full-current drops as though they were measured at the 3.45mA/channel operating point.

limits: Conversation capture refs are execution-session references, not portable repository assets; durable authority remains the official URLs, exact page numbers and source revisions above.
This evidence verifies datasheet polarity/pin/current-table interpretation only. It is not ECAD footprint, routed-board, optical-output or physical-bench evidence.
